title: Minyamin Kandoka, a jar seller
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Chullin 49b relates that his jar of honey was left uncovered, and he came before Rava, etc.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: מט: gives Chullin 49b under the colon convention, without fresh named-witness verification.
איגלי ליה is read as his jar was left uncovered, not spilled or revealed to him. The lexical correction is distinct from independent passage verification.

מוכר כדים explicitly supplies jar seller; Kandoka’s vowels remain conventional, with no identity binding. וכו׳ is retained as etc., marking Hyman’s truncated quotation. Rava is supplied as the unprefixed name רבא, not an independently supplied רב title.
